correctness.rationale: Direct source RESULT.md (Git blob 97b759151822c26d0fc60f3121da34cb3647858b): the forbidden t-cliques are precisely central C and the pendant petals. Omitting central C gives join X=*A_i, where each positive-petal factor A_i=Delta(U_i) union (c_i*B_i) is the suspension of B_i=* partial Delta(W_ij), an integral sphere of dimension q_i(t-2); q_i=0 instead makes X a cone. Restoring central C via X=K union Delta(C)*L with intersection P=partial Delta(C)*L ~= S^E, E=(q+1)(t-2), gives the unsaturated inclusion P->K an integral homology isomorphism. In the saturated case, primitive local suspension cycles gamma_i=c_i*z_i-u_i join to a generator Gamma of H_{E+1}(X), whose unique C-containing chain is C*(z_1*...*z_t); the Mayer-Vietoris boundary is +/-1, so K is integral acyclic. Simply connectivity is justified by complete 2-skeleton for t>=4, or cones over forbidden triangle boundaries for t=3 (q=0 handled directly). Whitehead upgrades the two homological conclusions to homotopy sphere or contractibility. Independently generated finite cases and exact Euler checks matched; all-parameter claims rely on the proof rather than mod-two enumeration.
